name: PAN and TAN
issuing_authority: Income Tax Department, Government of India
required_documents: Identity and address proof of proprietor/partners/directors
notes: PAN is foundational for business tax identity.
TAN may be required when TDS compliance applies.
verification_notes: Verify latest PAN/TAN process and document checklist on Income Tax portal.

name: GST Registration

requires_additional_info: Exact annual turnover estimate in INR
Whether interstate taxable supplies are made

notes: Applicability depends on turnover, category, location, and compulsory registration conditions.
verification_notes: GST thresholds and compulsory registration conditions must be verified from current official GST guidance.

name: Udyam (MSME) Registration
issuing_authority: Ministry of MSME, Government of India
notes: MSME classification depends on investment and turnover criteria.
verification_notes: Confirm current MSME classification criteria on Udyam portal before filing.

name: Shops and Establishments Registration

requires_additional_info: Exact office/shop location and local municipal jurisdiction

notes: State and city-specific registration process varies.
verification_notes: Verify exact state portal and local process before filing.

name: EPFO Registration

requires_additional_info: Employee joining dates and payroll setup details

notes: Thresholds and special conditions can change over time.
verification_notes: Verify current EPFO applicability criteria on official EPFO portal.

name: ESIC Registration

requires_additional_info: Employee wage details for ESIC wage-threshold check

notes: Wage limits and state-specific applicability may affect final obligation.
verification_notes: Confirm current ESIC wage and employee criteria on official ESIC portal.

name: FSSAI Registration/Licence
issuing_authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India

requires_additional_info: Exact food activity category and scale of operations

notes: Registration vs state/central licence depends on scale and business type.
verification_notes: Verify final category and requirements on FoSCoS portal.

name: Professional Tax Registration
issuing_authority: State Commercial Tax / Professional Tax Departments
notes: Applicable only in specific states with Professional Tax provisions.
verification_notes: Confirm applicability and rates on relevant state tax portal.

name: Trade Licence
notes: Local body requirements differ significantly by city/municipality.
verification_notes: Confirm requirements on local municipal portal before applying.

name: Import Export Code (IEC)
notes: IEC is generally required for import/export of goods/services under applicable frameworks.
verification_notes: Verify latest DGFT guidelines and exemptions before filing.
